fato_historico: 2004: Beslan school siege results in over 330 fatalities, including 186 children.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to cradle your heart in gentle warmth today. Much like the quiet resilience found in the depths of our shared human history, you may find that deep empathy is your greatest strength. It is a good time to protect your peace, cherish your loved ones, and transform past shadows into a powerful light of compassion.
frase_do_dia: The softest light can illuminate the darkest corners of the human spirit.
significado_numero: A sacred number representing spiritual growth, introspection, and deep emotional wisdom.
conselho: Practice radical kindness and hold your loved ones closer than ever today.
